items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Rocker grabbed him [Abbey Brunus], put him in his place to play the carnival parade.

ctx.x: See? I see you. It's nice to meet you. So...

Well, he kept on playing until... with me, until this Mardi Gras Day action happened, when he sent little Brunus in his place, Abbey Brunus, see? Now, when he sent Abbey Brunus in his place, of course, I didn't have... I believe it was about two, three bands I had out only that day. Understand? And I never had enough room to make another band to send out, which I had the band ready if they wanted it. Well, I could send it out. See? And Brunus happened to be in Bearville that day, and Rocker grabbed him, put him…
Well, sometime Nick LaRocca told about that you used to have some of the men put potatoes in the horns. Do you remember that? Well...
